name: Mantasma
ability: Blindsight (its own: every move it uses hits) / Sniper (hidden)
look: a gargantuan yet cute eyeless mantis: a huge round head that is mostly a grinning maw of fangs glowing violet inside, leafy horn-feelers, four scythe arms edged with glowing ghost blades and eight dark legs ringed with ghostly stripes
entry: A Mawntis that hunted on a moonless night and came back as something else. It towers over the trees, its grin glows in the dark, and its ghostly scythes cut through anything without ever missing. Even so, it still clasps its forelegs together the way it did as a Prayling.
how: Evolve Mawntis at level 40 or higher at night.
Wild: very rare in dark forests and jungles at night.
